proves.claim: coreLines with checkTiming true adds the exclusive gate slot line after the check digest.

cli.logic-show-core.a-timed-check-prints.why: Without it, builders read a timed item as having no exclusive slot and release it for runner load.

proves.claim: coreLines with checkTiming false or absent returns exactly the lines it returned before.

cli.logic-show-core.an-untimed-check-pri.why: Without it, the timing line could leak onto untimed items and change every show.
